summary: Minerals Technologies filed an 8-K reporting completion of a $400 million offering of 7.500% senior notes due 2032, with proceeds plus cash on hand earmarked to redeem all outstanding 5.000% senior notes due 2028 and pay related fees. The notes, guaranteed by wholly owned domestic restricted subsidiaries, carry semi-annual interest each January 15 and July 15, beginning January 15, 2027, with a make-whole call before January 15, 2029, a 40% equity-clawback at 107.500%, and a 101% change-of-control put. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch redemption timing and leverage.
